lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: You did well.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: To keep the existence of Red Hood hidden,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I erased the memories of the two Nikkes

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: who trusted me most of all.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Was that the right thing to do?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Do you think I made the wrong choice?
It was a sacrifice for the greater good.
There had to have been a better choice.
I don't know.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: This was how my father would do things.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I despised him for that,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: yet when I found myself in the same situation,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I made the exact same choice he did.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Perhaps, but there wasn't enough time.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I was too inexperienced, and wasn't smart enough,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: and so I ended up repeating the sins of my father.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: That's okay.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: If you were in my shoes,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I'm curious as to what you would do.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: At any rate, what's done is done. There's no going back now.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Anyways, you performed admirably.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: Thank you.
What will you do now?

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I'll leave her be.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: All pursuits will be called off.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I made a choice that hurt her grievously,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: yet rather than attempt to harm me,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: she chose to run.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I'm grateful to her for that,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: and so I'll leave her alone.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I hope that she'll be able to live on.

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: As for me, when the opportunity presents itself,

lines.speaker: tacticaltitac
lines.text: I will make my amends.
